description:
Ask verified people a question and get their answers back as a distribution (ask), ask your own audience several questions behind one link (set), upload an image a question can show, or build a link for a person to press Ask themselves. ask and set spend credits within this connection's daily cap and need a fresh UUID as idempotency_key; retrying with the same key never charges twice. Uploading an image and building a link cost nothing. Ask about preferences and first impressions, never facts; read 50heads://guide for wording.

Pass action: one of ask, set, upload_image, build_link. Each action takes only its own arguments.
- ask: Ask verified people a question and get their answers back as a distribution. Spends credits, within this connection's daily cap. Needs a fresh UUID as idempotency_key; retrying with the same key never charges twice. Returns a task to wait on, or on older hosts a question_id: then call results with action wait. If the organization holds asks over a limit for a person's approval, status is pending_approval and the task is input_required until someone approves at approval.approve_url; a denial ends it as refused_by_policy. Call estimate (action quote) first. Ask about preferences and first impressions, never facts; read 50heads://guide for wording. For a yes-or-no decision, add question.go_rule to get a go or a no go when Yes clears your line. Arguments: question (required), idempotency_key (required), template_id, variants, then, project_id, labels, external_ref. Changes something; needs questions:write.
- set: Publish two to ten questions behind one link for people you know (your audience): they answer each in turn in the browser, about five seconds each, with no account. Each question keeps its own results (results, action get, per question_id); 5 credits an accepted answer, not verified by 50heads. Spends credits, within this connection's daily cap. Needs a fresh UUID as idempotency_key; retrying with the same key never charges twice. For one question use action ask with answered_by "private"; for verified heads use action ask. Arguments: questions (required), idempotency_key (required), max_answers, open_for_days, shown_as, public_results, project_id, labels. Changes something; needs questions:write.
- upload_image: Puts an image into 50heads so a question can show it: base64 bytes (data), or a public https link to copy (image_url). Returns image_url to use in a question's options or stimulus. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB; metadata is stripped and heads never load your server. Costs nothing. Arguments: image_url, data, content_type. Changes something; needs questions:write.
- build_link: A link to the 50heads portal with a question already filled in, for a person to check and ask themselves: text, type, options and images, heads, tier, countries and tags, or a template, follow-up or re-ask. Nothing is asked or spent. Use it when a person should press Ask, or to hand a draft to a colleague. No sign-in needed. Arguments: draft, template_id, follow_up_of, reask, bulk. Read-only; no sign-in needed.

action.description: What to do. One of: ask, set, upload_image, build_link. Each action takes its own arguments; see the tool description.

bulk.description: Open the bulk composer (CSV or image sets). (Used by: build_link.)

content_type.description: The type of data. Read from the bytes when left out. (Used by: upload_image.)

data.description: The image as base64 (a data: URL is fine): JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. The hosted server takes requests up to 1 MB, so send bigger files by image_url or through the stdio server. (Used by: upload_image.)

draft.description: The question to fill in: text, type, options and images, heads (n), tier, rush, countries and tags (targeting). Every field is optional. (Used by: build_link.)

targeting.description: Who answers. Omit to ask everyone who reads the language. Countries are free. Age, gender and each tag group are one trait each: up to 4, 3 credits an answer per trait (PickFu charges about $0.40). OR within a trait, AND across. estimate returns pool_size and a time that allows for it.

age_bands.description: Age bands heads declared, or from the ID check with verified_age.

country.description: ISO country codes, such as ["GB", "IE"]. See 50heads://countries.

tags.description: Tag ids from 50heads://targeting, any tier (heads declare them). Any tag in a group matches.

verified_age.description: Count only the age band from the Tier 2 ID check. Needs tier 2 or 3.

external_ref.description: Your own id for it (an order, a ticket, a test run). Set once; find it with results, action list. (Used by: ask.)

follow_up_of.description: Open a follow-up to this question_id. (Used by: build_link.)

idempotency_key.description: ask: A fresh UUID for this ask. Retrying with the same key returns the same question and never charges twice. set: A fresh UUID for this set. Retrying with the same key returns the same set and never charges twice.

image_url.description: A public https image to copy into 50heads. Use this for images already online. (Used by: upload_image.)

labels.description: ask: Labels to find it by later with results, action list. set: Labels on every question, to find them by later.

max_answers.description: The most answers each question accepts, 10 to 5000. Default 100. The reserve is questions × max_answers × 5 credits. (Used by: set.)

open_for_days.description: private only: days the link stays open. Default 7. (Used by: set.)

project_id.description: ask: File it in one of your projects. set: File every question in one of your projects.

public_results.description: People see each question's bars after their own answers. Default false. (Used by: set.)

question.description: The question. `type` picks the format; see 50heads://question-types for rules and examples. (Used by: ask.)

answered_by.description: Who answers. "heads" (default): verified people 50heads finds, priced by tier. "private": your own audience, through a link you share; people answer in the browser with no account, 5 credits an accepted answer, no tier, rush or targeting, never free text. go_above.description: The line, as a share of Yes from 0.5 to 0.95 in whole percentages (0.6 is 60%). The result is a go when the whole 95% range on the Yes share is above it.

context.description: One line of background shown under the question, only when a head needs it.

go_rule.description: Go or no go: for an approval-style question ("Would you sign up?", "Is this label clear enough to ship?"), go when Yes clears the line you set. On yes_mostly_no, Mostly counts as half a Yes. It is how these heads answered against your line, not a fact.

go_above.description: The line, as a share of Yes from 0.5 to 0.95 in whole percentages (0.6 is 60%). The result is a go when the whole 95% range on the Yes share is above it.

min_answers.description: Answers needed before the result can be a go or a no go: at least 5, at most n. Default 80% of n, rounded down.
